quote.quote: The single biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has taken place.
quote.author: George Bernard Shaw
quote.translation: 沟通中最大的问题是，人们误以为沟通已经发生了。
quote.explanation: 这句话提醒我们在职场中，仅仅发送信息不等于有效沟通；需要确认对方理解，避免误解。常用于讨论反馈或团队协作时强调清晰沟通的重要性。

vocabulary.example: We need to collaborate closely with the marketing team to launch the campaign on time.
vocabulary.translation: 我们需要与市场团队紧密合作，按时推出活动。

vocabulary.example: Could you clarify your point about the deadline? I'm not sure I understood you correctly.
vocabulary.translation: 你能澄清一下关于截止日期的观点吗？我不确定我理解得对不对。

vocabulary.example: I appreciate your constructive feedback on my presentation; it will help me improve.
vocabulary.translation: 我很感谢你对我演示的 constructive feedback（建设性反馈），它会帮助我改进。

vocabulary.example: We need to negotiate the terms of the contract before signing it.
vocabulary.translation: 在签合同之前，我们需要协商条款。

vocabulary.example: As a project manager, you must keep all stakeholders informed about the progress.
vocabulary.translation: 作为项目经理，你必须让所有利益相关者了解进展情况。

vocabulary.example: A concise email is more likely to be read and understood quickly.
vocabulary.translation: 简洁的邮件更容易被快速阅读和理解。

vocabulary.example: If the issue cannot be resolved at our level, we may need to escalate it to senior management.
vocabulary.translation: 如果问题在我们层面无法解决，我们可能需要将其上报给高层管理。

vocabulary.example: Please share the meeting agenda with all participants beforehand so they can prepare.
vocabulary.translation: 请提前与所有参会者分享会议议程，以便他们做好准备。

vocabulary.definition: 外交的；有策略的；委婉的
vocabulary.example: When giving negative feedback, it's important to be diplomatic to avoid hurting feelings.
vocabulary.translation: 给予负面反馈时，保持委婉很重要，以免伤害感情。

vocabulary.example: After a lengthy discussion, we finally reached a consensus on the budget allocation.
vocabulary.translation: 经过长时间的讨论，我们终于就预算分配达成了共识。

pattern.pattern: Could you please [verb]? (礼貌请求句型)
pattern.example: Could you please clarify the deadline for this report?
pattern.translation: 你能澄清一下这份报告的最后期限吗？
pattern.usage: 用于职场中礼貌地请求别人做某事，比 'Can you' 更正式、更委婉。搭配动词如 clarify, explain, send, review 等。

grammar.title: 被动语态在职场沟通中的使用
grammar.explanation: 被动语态 (be + past participle) 常用于职场沟通中，当动作执行者不重要、未知或想避免指责时。例如：'The report was submitted late.' 比 'You submitted the report late.' 更委婉。常用于正式邮件或会议记录中。
examples: The meeting has been rescheduled to Friday.
The decision was made after careful consideration.
This issue must be addressed immediately.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 'sen'，注意 /s/ 音要清晰，不要读成 /z/。结尾 /əs/ 发音轻短。

reading.title: The Art of Active Listening in the Workplace
reading.content: Active listening is more than just hearing words; it involves fully concentrating, understanding, and responding thoughtfully. In a professional setting, this skill can prevent misunderstandings and build trust. For example, when a colleague shares a concern, paraphrasing what they said—'So if I understand correctly, you're worried about the deadline?'—shows you value their input. It also encourages open dialogue. To practice active listening, maintain eye contact, avoid interrupting, and ask clarifying questions. This approach not only improves teamwork but also helps resolve conflicts more efficiently. Remember, effective communication is a two-way street; listening is just as important as speaking.
reading.translation: 主动倾听不仅仅是听到词语；它需要全神贯注、理解并深思熟虑地回应。在职场中，这种技能可以防止误解并建立信任。例如，当同事表达担忧时，复述他们的话——'所以如果我理解正确，你担心的是截止日期？'——表明你重视他们的意见。这也能鼓励开诚布公的对话。要练习主动倾听，保持眼神交流，避免打断，并提出澄清性问题。这种方法不仅能改善团队合作，还能更有效地解决冲突。记住，有效沟通是双向的；倾听与说话同样重要。
